name: Show
source: lane ON: 0x157220 (ret 8): the style flags (-1 keeps them), the window styles, SetWindowLong / ShowWindow / SetWindowPos, then the canvas event code 4

name: SetTopmost
source: lane ON: 0x156f00: SetWindowPos with HWND_TOPMOST when captionless and set, else HWND_NOTOPMOST (flags 0x503)

name: SetTitle
source: lane ON: 0x156f60: the title string assigned, converted (0x1b025d) and given to SetWindowTextA

name: SetSize
source: lane ON: 0x157040: right / bottom from the rectangle's left / top, then 0x155ab0 moves the window

name: SetMinSize
source: lane ON: 0x157190: stores the minimum, grows the window to it when the client area is smaller

name: PlaceOnMonitor
source: lane ON: 0x1555b0: centres the window in the monitor's rectangle (its slot 4) below the title bar offset

name: SetPowerFlags
source: lane ON: 0x157070: stores +0x14 and SetThreadExecutionState (bit 1 clear keeps the display awake); returns the previous state

name: SetActive
source: lane ON: 0x156ee0: SetActiveWindow(the window or null)

name: LockPaint
source: lane ON: 0x1561a0: counts +0x64 up; ValidateRect when the first lock finds a pending paint

name: UnlockPaint
source: lane ON: 0x157720: counts +0x64 down; InvalidateRect and the pending flag at zero

name: Repaint
source: lane ON: 0x157750: pending flag, then InvalidateRect and UpdateWindow unless locked

name: FillBackground
source: lane ON: 0x1556c0: FillRect of the client area with the background brush +0xa8

name: GetStyleFlags
source: lane ON: shared 0x149cf0 reads +0x10

name: GetTitle
source: lane ON: 0x155470: a copy of the title string handed to the caller's cIGZString (its slot 17)

name: GetClientRect
source: lane ON: 0x156d70: the client rectangle in screen coordinates (ClientToScreen of both corners); returns out

name: GetMinSize
source: lane ON: 0x1561f0: copies +0x88 / +0x8c to out; returns out

name: GetPowerFlags
source: lane ON: shared 0x149d00 reads +0x14

name: IsActiveWindow
source: lane ON: 0x1560f0: GetActiveWindow() == the window

name: IsMinimized
source: lane ON: 0x156160: IsIconic of the top-level ancestor

name: IsMaximized
source: lane ON: 0x156140: IsZoomed of the top-level ancestor

name: IsCaptionless
source: lane ON: 0x156120: GWL_STYLE & 0xc00000 == 0

name: SetFullscreen
source: lane ON: 0x1570a0: on = borderless topmost over the desktop; off = Show(-1, false) then 0x155ab0

name: GetHwnd
source: lane ON: shared 0x155e40 reads +0xa4

name: GetWindowClass
source: lane ON: 0x1556b0 reads the 16-bit window class atom +0xa0

name: SetMessageHook
source: lane ON: 0x154f20 (ret 8): adds the counted hook (its slot 3 sees every message) unless present, or removes it; false when nothing changed
